spans.s:
पट् पट्, cl. 1. P. पटति, पटितुम्, to go,
move: Caus. or cl. 10. P. पाटयति,
यितुम्, to split, cleave, tear, tear up, tear asunder,
tear open, divide, pierce, penetrate; to break, to
eradicate, remove; to pluck out; to cause to be
torn up; to speak; to shine; पटयति, -यितुम्, to
string; to surround, encircle, encompass, clothe; to
[]
distribute (?): Pass. of the Caus. पाट्यते, to be split
open, cleave asunder (intransitively).

पाट् पाट्, ind. an interjection used in call-
ing (सम्बोधने).

पट, अस्, अम्, m. n. (perhaps connected with
पत्त्र, and usually पटस्, m. in the sense of
‘cloth,’ &c.), woven cloth, cloth, a piece of cloth,
a garment, raiment; fine cloth; a veil or screen; a
piece of cloth or tablet or plate on which any-
thing may be written or painted [cf. पट्ट, col.
3]; (अस्), m. a species of tree, (see पियाल); a
species of bird; anything well made or polished,
= पुरस्-कृत; (ई), f. cloth, a particular sort of
cloth, coarse thick cloth, canvas; the curtain of a
stage; a screen of cloth surrounding a tent, an outer
tent; a coloured or chintz garment (?); (अम्), n. a
thatch, a roof (= पटल).
—पट-कार, अस्, m. a
weaver; a painter.
—पट-कुटी, f. a tent; a tent of
woollen cloth.
—पट-चौर, अस्, m. a cloth-stealer,
a shop-lifter.
—पट-मण्डप, अस्, m. ‘canvas
house,’ a tent.
—पट-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of
cloth; (अम्), n. a tent, a canvas house; a petticoat (?).
—पट-वाप, अस्, m. a tent, (for पट-वास.)
—पट-वास, अस्, m. a tent; a petticoat; perfumed
powder.
—पट-वासक, अस्, m. perfumed powder.
—पट-वेश्मन्, अ, n. a tent.
—पटाक्षेप (˚ट-
अक्˚), अस्, m. not tossing the stage curtain, not
pushing it aside, (probably the correct reading would
be अ-पटी-क्षेप.)
—पटी-क्षेप, अस्, m. tossing
aside the stage curtain, (denoting in theatrical lan-
guage a hurried entrance on the stage.)
—पटोतज
(˚ट-उत्˚), अम्, n. a tent; sunshine (?).

पट्ट पट्ट, अस्, m. (probably for पत्त्र),
a slab [cf. शिला-प्˚], tablet (for painting), plate (of
metal for inscription or engraving royal edicts, grants,
&c.); a patent, document, royal grant or order
[]
(written on copper, stone, &c. = नृप-शासन); a
stone for grinding with, a muller (?); = पट, cloth,
coloured cloth, fine cloth, woven silk (= कौषेय);
a strip (e. g. निर्मोक-पट्टास्, strips of cast off skin);
a bandage, ligature, swath, cloth bound round a
sore, &c.; a frontlet, fillet or cloth worn round the
head, turban, (of which five kinds are enumerated,
viz. those of the king, queen, prince, general,) and
the prasāda-paṭṭa or turban of honour worn as a
token of royal favour); a coloured silk turban; a
diadem; an upper or outer garment; a plant com-
monly called Pāt (Corchorus Olitorius) from the
fibres of which or jute a coarse sackcloth and cordage
are prepared (?); a place where four roads meet (=
चतुष्-पथ); a shield (?); a chair, stool (?); N.
of various men; (ई), f. an ornament of the forehead;
a martingale, horse's girth (= तल-सारक); N. of
a certain species of the Lodhra or Lodh plant (=
क्रमुक, रोध्र, लोध्र, पट्टिका-लोध्र); red
Lodh, Symplocos Racemosa; (अम्), n. a city, town,
village, (probably the Pattah of the South; cf. पट्-
टन, पत्तन; cf. also अंशु-प्˚.)
—पट्ट-ज,
अम्, n. a sort of cloth, probably a kind of canvas or
sackcloth.
—पट्ट-देवी, f. a queen (decorated with
the tiara), the principal wife of a king.
—पट्ट-
बन्ध, अस्, m. or पट्ट-बन्धन, अम्, n. bind-
ing or crowning the head with a fillet or tiara.
—पट्ट-महिषी, f. the principal wife of a king;
[cf. पट्ट-देवी.]
—पट्ट-रङ्ग, अम्, n. a plant
used in dying, Cæsalpina Sappan.
—पट्ट-रञ्जन
or पट्ट-रञ्जनक, अम्, n. Cæsalpina Sappan.
—पट्ट-राज्ञी, f. the principal queen.
—पट्ट-
वस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, or पट्ट-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
attired in coloured cloth or wove silk.
—पट्ट-शाक,
अस्, अम्, m. n. a species of pot-herb, commonly also
Nālita or Lalita, Corchorus Capsularis.
—पट्ट-
सूत्र-कार, अस्, m. a silk-weaver, (designation of a
class of Hindūs who are feeders of silk-worms and silk-
twisters.)
—पट्टाभिषेक (˚ट-अभ्˚), अस्, m. the
consecration of the tiara.
—पट्टार्हा (˚ट-अर्˚), f.
‘worthy of the turban,’ the principal queen.
—पट्टो-
पाध्याय (˚ट-उप्˚), अस्, m. the writer of royal grants
or patents and other similar documents.

पाट पाट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पट्), breadth,
expanse, extension; (in geometry) the intersection of
a prolonged side and perpendicular or the figure
formed by such intersection; (आ), f. regular or suc-
cessive order, series, succession.

पाटा पाटा, f., Ved. a species of plant
(= पाठा ?).

पटक, अस्, m. cotton cloth; a camp, encamp-
ment; the half of a village, (for पाटक.)

पटाक पटाक, अस्, m. a bird [cf. पैटाक];
(आ), f. a flag, banner (= पताका).

पट्टक, अस्, m. a plate of metal (usually copper)
for inscription or engraving royal edicts; a cloth, ban-
dage; a document (said to be also अम्, n.); (इका), f.
a tablet, plate; a document; a bandage, frontlet,
ribbon, a piece of cloth; a piece of wove silk, cloth
used for a turban; a species of tree (= पट्टिकाख्य,
पट्टी); N. of a woman.
—पट्टिकाख्य (˚का-आख्˚),
अस्, m. a species of tree (= पट्टी).
—पट्टिका-लोध्र,
अस्, m. a species of Lodhra (= पट्टी, क्रमुक).
—पट्टिका-वायक, अस्, m. a silk-weaver, ribbon-
weaver.

पाटक, अस्, m. a splitter, divider, one who cleaves
or tears asunder; the half of a village, part of a
village, a kind of village; a shore, bank; a flight of
steps leading to the water; a kind of musical instru-
ment; a long span (= महा-किष्कु); expense or
loss of capital or stock; throwing dice.

पटर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (Ved.) a ray (of sun-
light); (अस्), m., N. of the third of the seven suns,
(see Viṣṇu-Purāṇa
VI. 2

, where the names of the
seven suns are given as Ārāga, Bhrāja, Paṭala,
Pataṅga, Svamābhāk, Jyotiṣmat, and Sa-vibhāsa);
an epithet of Varuṇa.
पट्टार पट्टार, N. of a district.
पटरक, अस्, m. a species of plant (= गुन्द्र).

पटल, अम्, n. a roof, thatch, (in this sense the
fem. form पटली is also given); a cover, covering,
veil, coating, an enclosing or surrounding skin or
membrane (especially over the eyes), a film over
the eyes; a basket; a heap, mass, number, quantity
or multitude, (often at the end of a comp. with
words denoting ‘cloud,’ e. g. जलद-पटल, a
mass of clouds; the fem. forms पटली and पटला
are also given); train, retinue; a mark on the
forehead or other parts of the body with sandal-wood
(either as an ornament or sectarian mark); a spot,
circle, district (?); (अस्), m. ‘cataract of the eye,’ N.
of one of the seven suns at the end of the world; (अस्,
अम्), m. n. a section, chapter, or portion of a book
(especially of the Ṛg-veda Prātiśākhya); (अस्, ई),
m. f. a tree; a stalk; a book (?); (in law) the filing
of suits, (gender doubtful.)
—पटल-प्रान्त, अस्, m.
the edge of a thatch.
पट्टला पट्टला, f. a district, a community.

पाटल, अस्, आ, अम् (said by some to be connected
with पाट above), pale-red, of a pink or pale-red
colour; rose colour; pallid; (अस्, ई, अम्), made of
the Pāṭalī or forming a part of it; (अस्), m. a pale-
red hue, rose colour, redness; the trumpet-flower,
Bignonia Suaveolens (a tree with sweet-scented blos-
soms); a species of rice ripening in the rains; N. of
a man; (आ), f. Bignonia Suaveolens (both the tree
and its blossom); red Lodhra; a kind of fresh-water
fish; an epithet of Durgā; a form of Dākṣāyaṇī;
(अम्, आ), n. f. the flower of the Bignonia Suaveolens;
saffron.
—पाटल-गण्ड-लेख, अस्, आ, अम्, having
the complexion of the cheek reddened.
—पाटल-
द्रुम, अस्, m. a species of tree, Rottleria Tinctoria
(= पुन्-नाग).
—पाटल-पुष्प-सन्निभ, अम्,
n. a species of medicinal plant (= पद्म-काष्ठ).
[]
—पाटला-वती, f., N. of a river; an epithet of
Durgā.
—पाटलोपल (˚ल-उप्˚), अम्, n. a ruby.
पाटल पाटल. See p. 561, col. 3.

पटलक (gender doubtful), a heap, &c. See
पटल above.
पाटलक, अस्, आ, अम्, of a pale-red colour, pink.

पटि, इस्, f. (for पटी, cf. पट), a kind of cloth;
a species of aquatic plant (= कुम्भिका).
पटि पटि. See col. 2.

पट्टि पट्टि, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(also spelt पत्ति.)

पाटी, f. arithmetic; a species of shrub (= बला).
—पाटी-गणित, अम्, n. arithmetic.
पटिका, f. woven cloth.
पट्टिका पट्टिका. See under पट्टक above.

पटच्चर पटच्चर, अस्, m. (probably fr.
पटत् + चर, पट् being an imitative sound, per-
haps of creeping stealthily), a thief, a robber [cf.
पातच्चर]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (अम्),
n. old or ragged clothes.

पाटच्चर पाटच्चर, अस्, m. (fr. पटच्चर),
a thief, robber, shop-lifter.
पटत् पटत्, ind. the sound पटत्.

पटत्ककन्थ पटत्क-कन्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
town, (Pāṇ.
पटपटा पट-पटा, ind. an imitative sound.

पटभाक्ष पटभाक्ष, अस्, m. an instru-
ment for looking (at any object), an optical instru-
ment.

पटह पटह, अस्, अम्, m. n. (but com-
monly m.; probably fr. पट + ह, rt. पन्), a
kettle-drum, drum, war-drum, tabor; (अस्), m. be-
ginning, undertaking; hurting, injuring, killing.
[]
—पटह-घोषक, अस्, m. a crier who beats a
drum before making a proclamation.
—पटह-
ता, f. the noise or function of a drum.
—पटह-
ध्वनि, इस्, m. the sound of a drum; (इस्, इस्, इ),
sounding like a drum.
—पटह-भ्रमण, अम्, n.
going about with a drum to call people together.
पटालुका पटालुका, f. a leech; [cf. जलुका.]
पटिष्ठ पटिष्ठ, पटीयस्. See पटु below.

पटिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, very sharp or clever,
sharpest, &c.

पटिस पटिस, अस्, m. (incorrect for पट्-
टिश?), a sort of weapon.

पट्टिश पट्टिश, अस्, m. a sort of weapon, a
kind of axe; a spear with a sharp edge.

पट्टिस, अस्, m. a kind of weapon with three
points.

पट्टीश, अस्, m. (probably for पट्टिश), a kind of
weapon used by Śiva; (in Hari-vaṃśa 10658, Śiva
is called Triśūla-paṭṭīśa-dhara.)

पटीर पटीर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पट्),
a ball for playing with; the god of love; sandal-
wood; (अम्), n. Catechu (= खदिर); the belly;
anything that can be carried off or taken away (=
हरणीय); a sieve; height; a radish; a field; a
cloud; bamboo manna; rheumatism; catarrh.

पाटीर, अस्, m. a field; a pungent root, a kind
of radish; the pith or manna of the bamboo; a cloud;
a sieve, searce, cribble; tin; disease arising from
wind, catarrh; sandal.

पटु पटु, उस्, उस् or वी, उ (said to be fr. rt.
पट्), sharp, pointed (as a ray of light); clear, shrill,
ringing, sharp-sounding, clear-sounding, crackling,
rustling (said of sound); pungent, acid, hot; sharp,
clever, smart, dexterous, skilful, crafty, sly, cunning;
sensible, intellectual; busy, active, violent, strong,
intense; harsh, hard, rough, fierce; hale, healthy;
cruel, unmerciful, unfeeling; contumelious (as speech
&c.); eloquent, loquacious, talkative [cf. वाक्-पटु];
blown, expanded; apt, disposed; (उस्), m. the tree
Trichosanthes Diœca; the leaf of the Trichosanthes
Diœca; the plant Momordica Charantia; a kind of
perfume (= चोरक); N. of a man; (अवस्), m. pl.,
N. of a people; (उस्, उ), m. n. a mushroom;
(उ), n. salt.
—पटु-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, tolerably
clever, pretty skilful.
—पटु-जातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, of
a clever sort, pretty clever or skilful.
—पटु-तर,
अस्, आ, अम्, more sharp, sharper, keener, clearer;
more clever, &c.
—पटु-ता, f. cleverness; elo-
quence; [cf. वाक्-प्˚.]
—पटु-तृणक, अम्, n. a
species of pungent grass.
—पटु-त्व, अम्, n. sharp-
ness, keenness (as of sight), cleverness, skilfulness,
eloquence.
—पटु-देशीय or पटु-देश्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, tolerably sharp, almost clever, cleverish.
—पटु-
पत्त्रिका, f. a species of shrub (= क्षुद्र-चञ्चु).
—पटु-पर्णिका, f. a species of plant (= क्षीरिणी).
—पटु-पर्णी, f. Bryonia Grandis, a species of
cucurbitaceous plant.
—पटु-मत्, आन्, m., N. of a
prince.
—पटु-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
—पटु-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, very clever.
पटिमन्, आ, m. sharpness, &c. (Pāṇ.
पटीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, sharper, more clever.
पटुक, अस्, m. Trichosanthes Diœca.
पटुश पटुश, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa.
पटुस पटुस, अस्, m., N. of a prince.

पटोल पटोल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
पट्), a species of cucumber, commonly Palwal,
Trichosanthes Diœca, = पटु; (अम्), n. the fruit of
the above; a sort of cloth, a kind of chintz [cf.
पट]; (ई), f. a small cucumber, either the same as
above or another species, Luffa Acutangula (=
कोशातकी).

पटोलक, अस्, m. a muscle or oyster (= शुक्ति)
compared to the shape of the Trichosanthes; (इका),
f. = पटोली, a species of cucumber.

पटौर पटौर, अस्, m., Ved. (according to
the Pada-pāṭha = पट + ऊर), a particular member
of the body (?).
पट्टि-कार, अस्, ई, m. f. a silk-weaver (?).
पट्टिन्, ई, m. red Lodh.

पाटिन् पाटिन्, ई, m. a species of fish de-
scribed as having many teeth; [cf. पाठीन.]

पट्टिल, अस्, m. a species of plant (= पूतिक-
रज), Cæsalpina Bonducella.

पट्टोलिका, f. a title deed, a Paṭṭa, a lease, &c.;
a written legal opinion.

पट्टन पट्टन, अम् and ई, n. f. a city; [cf.
पत्तन; cf. also देव-पल्ली-प्˚, धर्म-प्˚.]

पाटन, अम्, n. splitting, cleaving, slitting up,
tearing up, breaking, cutting to pieces, destroying.
—पाटन-क्रिया, f. lancing an abscess or ulcer.

पट्टव पट्टव (probably for पट्ट-ज), a
kind of cloth.

पाटव पाटव, अस्, m. (fr. पटु), a son or
descendant of Paṭu; a pupil of Paṭu; (अस्, ई, अम्),
clever, sharp, dexterous; (अम्), n. sharpness, acute-
ness, intensity, energy; cleverness, skill, dexterity,
talent, eloquence; quickness, rashness, precipitation;
health.
पट्टिशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, armed with a Paṭṭiśa.

पट्टेरक पट्टेरक, the plant Cyperus Hex-
astachyus Communis.

पाटलि, इस्, ई, m. f. the trumpet-flower, Bignonia
Suaveolens; a species of rice; (ई), f., N. of a city;
of a daughter of king Mahendra-varman.
—पाटलि-
पुत्र or पाटलि-पुत्रक, अम्, n., N. of the capital
of Magadha near the confluence of the Śoṇa and the
Ganges, supposed to be the ancient Palibothra and
the modern Patna.
—पाटलिपुत्र-नामधेय, अम्,
n., scil. नगर, a city called Pāṭali-putra.

पाटलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the secrets of
others; one who knows time and place; (अस्), m. a
pupil; (अम्), n., N. of a town (= पाटलि-पुत्र).
पाटलिमन्, आ, m. a pale-red or rose colour.
पाटल्या, f. a multitude of Pāṭalā flowers.

पाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn, split, broken, divided;
epithet of a form of fracture of the leg.

पाटविक, अस्, ई, अम्, clever, adroit, dexterous;
cunning, crafty, fraudulent.

पाटहिका पाटहिका, f. a small shrub, Abrus
Precatorius; [cf. गुञ्ज.]

पाटिकावाडि पाटिकावाडि, N. of a village
(probably Putcabarry).

पाटूर पाटूर, अस्, m., Ved. a particular
part of an animal near the ribs.

पाट्य पाट्य, अम्, n. a kind of vegetable
(= पट्ट-शाक).
